title: Therapy Goal Progress by Theme
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=therapy:homework
| search progress_pct=*
| stats avg(progress_pct) as progress_pct count as goals by theme
| sort 0 - progress_pct
description: Ranks themess by therapy goal progress.
value: Goal progress by theme keeps broad therapy work from feeling too abstract to measure.
implementation: Send therapy goal progress events to `index=personal` and keep `theme` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of therapy goal progress by themes.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which themess stand out most for therapy goal progress.
